outputs: Harmful responses generated by base LLMs during jailbreak attacks
The generated outputs include responses to harmful prompts, such as tutorials on illegal activities, which are evaluated for harmfulness and evasion of guardrails.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on jailbreak attacks against LLM guardrails. The main NLG task is dialogue generation of harmful content. Key contributions include the PRP attack method and evaluation of guardrail effectiveness. Metadata extraction was generally good but needed clarification on which models are generators vs. evaluators.
